stories.title: US prosecutors reopen case of alleged rape at Cornell University
stories.summary: US prosecutors reopened the case of an alleged gang rape at Cornell University after the woman filed a civil lawsuit claiming she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house in 2024. The move restarts a high-profile criminal inquiry into an incident that has drawn scrutiny over how the university handled it.

stories.title: Germany's foreign minister backs ICC despite US sanctions
stories.summary: Germany's foreign minister visited the International Criminal Court to pledge full support for the court despite sanctions imposed by the Trump administration. The visit signals continued European backing for the Hague-based court amid pressure from Washington.

stories.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with a ChatGPT office suite
stories.summary: OpenAI rolled out what amounts to an office suite inside ChatGPT, putting the assistant in direct competition with Microsoft's productivity tools. The launch is OpenAI's clearest push yet into workplace software.

stories.title: AI app maker Wabi pivots to a messaging experience
stories.summary: AI-powered app maker Wabi is pivoting from no-code app building to a messaging experience. The shift reflects how quickly AI startup focuses are changing as founders chase user traction.

stories.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
stories.summary: OpenAI launched Dots, an expressive agentic avatar tied to ChatGPT. It marks the company's move toward more personality-driven, agent-based AI assistants.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, cheaper model that nears GPT-6 Astra
stories.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, saying it nearly matches its flagship GPT-6 Astra at a lower cost. The launch gives developers and consumers a cheaper option as OpenAI expands its model lineup.

stories.title: Browns hold main practice ahead of Thursday night vs. Steelers
stories.summary: The Browns held their key practice session on Tuesday as they prepared for Thursday Night Football against the Pittsburgh Steelers. The AFC North matchup puts a share of first place on the line early in the season.

stories.title: Browns' Elgton Jenkins listed as DNP with concussion ahead of Steelers
stories.summary: Browns center Elgton Jenkins was listed as a did-not-participate with a concussion on Monday's walkthrough report ahead of the Steelers game. Losing the starting center would weaken the offensive line against a strong Pittsburgh front.

stories.title: Big week in Cleveland sports as Browns host Steelers
stories.summary: Cleveland hosts Pittsburgh on Thursday night with the winner ending Week 4 no worse than tied for first in the AFC North. It is a big week for Cleveland sports as the 2-1 Browns look to build momentum.

stories.title: Aston Martin confirms Alonso and Stroll for 2027 F1 season
stories.summary: Aston Martin confirmed Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll for the 2027 Formula 1 season, extending Alonso's career into a 24th campaign. The news ends months of speculation about Alonso's future.

stories.title: Perez warns F1 power-unit gaps are becoming dangerous
stories.summary: Sergio Perez said differences in power-unit deployment between Formula 1 engine manufacturers created a dangerous closing-speed problem in Azerbaijan. His comments add to the season's growing debate over 2026 safety regulations.

stories.title: Mercedes passes Ferrari for most F1 engine wins
stories.summary: Mercedes moved past Ferrari to become Formula 1's most successful engine manufacturer by grand prix victories, reaching 252 wins in Azerbaijan. It is a milestone in the sport's longest-running engine rivalry.

stories.title: Pirelli targets higher-degradation tires for 2027 F1 season
stories.summary: Pirelli is developing Formula 1 tires with greater degradation for 2027 to create more strategic variation and fewer routine one-stop races. The approach aims to shake up race strategy across the grid.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: Local reports identified Patrick Havas as the alleged attacker at a Columbus campaign event for Dr. Amy Acton. The incident has drawn attention to the high-profile local race as it is investigated.

stories.title: Columbus man reverses plea in deadly road-rage shooting
stories.summary: A Columbus man who had pled guilty in a deadly road-rage shooting reversed his plea after retaining new counsel. The case will now move forward with the guilty plea withdrawn.
